execution_note: job-tvuat (jobs/cell_step_profile, rule v1-A2, PR #86 @54ee89d) ADOPT: chosen ckpt_rows_lean = per-block activation checkpointing keeping the cache fork, the step's 8 rows batched in length-sorted groups (<= 8 rows, <= 8,192 padded tokens per call; long rows split a step into several groups), chunked_lean WKV (our pure-PyTorch rearrangement of the vendored chunked WKV, CPU-equivalence-tested; no GPU gate needed); measured median step 8.25 s, 0 OOMs, projection 1,382 steps / 11,056 rows in 190 min (receipt receipts/2026-10-07-D-cell-step-profile-tvuat). Execution flags are not in the TrainConfig hash (same loss and gradients). rwkv7_wkv applies to both arms (child: run_cell / m2_gates; parent: score_parent). 'fla' only after jobs/fla_rwkv7 ADOPT + GPU_VERIFIED.
max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 532-min cell phase: D3's 230-min cell = 190 train + 40 overhead (load/draw/tokenize 10 for 24k rows + smoke/ladder 10 + dev cards 10 + checkpoints/margin 10); tokenize scales with rows: 300k at D1's 10 min / 24k = 125 min (+115), so overhead 155 and training = 532 - 155 = 377 min. At the fast_fla step (3.88-3.9 s / 8-row step, job-9bs8w; K<=16 d1_fast rows) 377 min ~= 5,800 steps ~= 46k rows (~15 %% of the 300k draw); max_steps 12,000 does not bind, the time cap does. v3w / K>16 rows are longer, so expect fewer rows. Cumulative over restarts.
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: M2_RUN_SPEC r=256 adds ~1.15B trainable params (~18 GB of fp32 weights + grads + Adam) on top of 26.5 GB bf16 weights and the un-checkpointed cache-fork activations; r=64 (the pilot's pre-registered rank) keeps the T=2048 ladder rung inside the 76 GB stop
train_max_k_note: D8 code (#221 on agent-main): K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap (train.m2_gates.unit_spec, run_cell eval_items). B1 100k-v2 carries rows with > 16 options (BANKING77 77-option catalogs, Glaive catalog views K 17-27), which max_k 16 alone would drop.
row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked continuations per backbone call; a row with K > 160 runs alone, and a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group under cont_plan single. Worst call = 8,192 prefix tokens + 160 copies ~= 53.8 GB (tvuat ladder 1,024 rung) + 80 x <= 87 MB ~= 61 GB < 76 GB stop (D8 sizing). Not in the TrainConfig hash; never binds on K <= 16 steps (8 x 16 = 128).
